snippets.kit: The character wears its yellow cycling helmet with three black vents and its yellow jersey with a small round black collar and a short black zip line, black cycling shorts and black cycling shoes with cream soles. No bike.
snippets.swim: Swim kit instead of the cycling kit: a yellow (#FBE122) swim cap with three small black stripes instead of the helmet, black swim goggles pushed up onto the cap, a yellow swimsuit, bare feet. A few light blue (#8CC4F0) water drops dripping off. No bike.
snippets.run: Running kit instead of the cycling kit: no helmet, a yellow (#FBE122) sweatband around the head, the yellow jersey as a running shirt, black running shorts and black running shoes with cream soles. No bike.
snippets.bike: The character wears its yellow cycling helmet with three black vents and its yellow jersey with a small round black collar and a short black zip line, black cycling shorts and black cycling shoes with cream soles. The bike: road bike with a yellow frame and fork (#FBE122), black handlebar tape, black saddle. Both wheels identical and WITHOUT spokes: a thick black tyre, a yellow rim ring inside it, a solid cream (#FFFDF5) inner disc and a small black hub dot in the center. No spokes, no spoke lines.

monkeys.name: Ab geht's
monkeys.scene: Standing, body turned a little to the viewer's right, pointing ahead to the right with one arm stretched out, the other hand on the hip, as if saying "that way, let's go!". Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Daumen hoch
monkeys.scene: Standing, a big thumbs-up raised to the right at shoulder height, the other hand holding a light blue (#8CC4F0) water bottle with a gold (#C99A2E) cap, as if saying "you've got this!". Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Bananen-Mikro
monkeys.scene: Standing, holding a yellow banana in one hand like a microphone in front of the mouth, the other arm open wide to the right as if speaking to a cheering crowd. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Muckis
monkeys.scene: Standing, both arms raised and flexed to show off the biceps, a few short black effort lines beside the arms, grinning while talking. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Hallo du!
monkeys.scene: Standing, waving high with the hand on the viewer's right, two short black motion arcs beside the waving hand, the other arm relaxed at the side, as if calling a teammate over. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Ab ins Wasser
monkeys.scene: Standing fresh out of the pool, a cream towel slung over one shoulder, the other hand giving a thumbs-up to the right. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{swim}}

monkeys.name: Laufschuhe an
monkeys.scene: Jogging on the spot, one knee up, arms bent in a running swing, turned toward the right as if inviting the viewer to run along. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{run}}

monkeys.name: Aufsitzen
monkeys.scene: Standing beside a road bike, one hand on the handlebar, the other pointing at the saddle as if saying "hop on!"; the bike stands to the left of the character, so the right side stays free. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{bike}}

monkeys.name: Kuchenstopp
monkeys.scene: Standing, holding up a big slice of cake on a small cream plate in one hand (gold sponge, cream filling, a yellow topping) and a cream coffee cup in the other, as if announcing the team's cake stop. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Regenheld
monkeys.scene: Standing in the rain, cheerful anyway, holding a big yellow umbrella over the helmet, a few light blue (#8CC4F0) raindrops falling around it. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}

monkeys.name: Bonjour Paris
monkeys.scene: Standing, holding a long gold baguette up like a trophy pointing to the right, a small black beret on top of the helmet, a tiny black-outlined Eiffel Tower in cream and gold on the left behind the character. Mouth open mid-sentence. {{kit}}
